description: Implementation of SpdyHttpStream class handling SPDY protocol streams, including request/response management, header validation, data transfer, and stream lifecycle.

classes.name: SpdyHttpStream
classes.description: Handles SPDY protocol stream operations including request/response lifecycle, data transfer, and stream management.

methods.name: ValidatePushedHeaders
methods.description: Validates headers for server push, ensuring ranges and Vary headers match expectations.

methods.name: InitializeStreamHelper
methods.description: Initializes stream delegate and ALPN negotiation status.

methods.name: ReadAndSendRequestBodyData
methods.description: Reads data from upload stream and sends it over the SPDY stream.

methods.name: SendEmptyBody
methods.description: Sends an empty data frame to close the stream.

methods.name: ResetStream
methods.description: Resets the SPDY stream with a given error code.

methods.name: OnRequestBodyReadCompleted
methods.description: Handles completion of upload data read, sending data or handling errors.

methods.name: DoBufferedReadCallback
methods.description: Processes buffered response data and invokes response callback.

methods.name: DoRequestCallback
methods.description: Runs the stored request callback with the result.

methods.name: DoResponseCallback
methods.description: Runs the stored response callback with the result.
